purpose: DII membership and candidacy notes; distinguishes conference schedule participants from certified NCAA membership.

lackawanna-college.status: PSAC schedule participant; NCAA DII membership contingent
lackawanna-college.note: Included in 2026–27 PSAC basketball schedules, but not an active Division II member; games do not count toward PSAC standings.

loyola-university-new-orleans.status: Joining GSC / starting DII transition in fall 2027
loyola-university-new-orleans.note: Announced 2027–28 Gulf South Conference entry; not a 2026–27 NCAA DII basketball member.

monroe-university.status: CACC scheduling partner; DII application pending
monroe-university.note: School states it is not currently an NCAA member; application and provisional membership process pending during 2026–27.

texas-wesleyan-university.status: Future DII candidate; application submitted October 2026
texas-wesleyan-university.note: Applied for DII membership in October 2026; expected DII competition would begin in 2028–29 if approved.

texas-a-m-university-texarkana.status: NCAA Division II reclassification year 1; competes in NAIA during 2026–27
texas-a-m-university-texarkana.note: The Lone Star Conference explicitly states the Eagles compete in the NAIA throughout 2026–27 despite beginning NCAA DII reclassification September 1, 2026. LSC basketball competition starts in 2027–28; exclude from 2026–27 DII Elo and missing-DII-schedule recovery counts.

azusa-pacific.status: Reclassifying from NCAA Division II to Division III in 2026–27
azusa-pacific.note: Azusa Pacific left the DII PacWest and joined the Division III SCIAC reclassification process effective September 1, 2026. It must not be included in DII Elo.

west-florida.status: Competing in NCAA Division I Atlantic Sun Conference beginning fall 2026
west-florida.note: The University of West Florida explicitly announced its 2026-27 move to Division I/ASUN. Do not count the Argonauts as a missing DII schedule or award DII Elo.

texas-a-m-university-texarkana.status: NCAA Division II reclassification year 1; competes in NAIA during 2026–27
texas-a-m-university-texarkana.note: The Lone Star Conference explicitly states the Eagles compete in the NAIA throughout 2026–27 despite beginning NCAA DII reclassification September 1, 2026. LSC basketball competition starts in 2027–28; exclude from 2026–27 DII Elo and missing-DII-schedule recovery counts.

university-of-west-florida.status: Competing in NCAA Division I Atlantic Sun Conference beginning fall 2026
university-of-west-florida.note: West Florida university programs transitioned to Division I/ASUN beginning fall 2026, not part of the 2026-27 DII ratings.

source_policy: University, official athletics and conference statements checked against announcement dates. DII regular-season schedule inclusion is distinct from active NCAA membership.
